sources.citation: Windfuhr, Gernot. 1999. FĀRS viii. Dialects. Encyclopaedia Iranica IX/4, pp. 362-373 (online ed.). [Glottolog ref 552940, the only 'overview' reference on the nort2640 page]
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No word-stress statement for any Fars dialect, and none for the Northwestern enclaves it names (Sivandi, Kalani-Abdu'i Kurdish, Koruni Laki, Tall-e Khedashk Gurani, Koroshi Balochi). Only incidental remarks: 'The indefinite marker of noun phrases is unstressed -ī in all dialects' and (Buringuni/Papuni) 'present and past perfect are marked by the copula with stress on the verb stem'. Its Appendix 1 explicitly assigns each Northwestern-type pocket in Fars to Sivandi, Kurdish, Laki, Gurani or Balochi.

sources.citation: Kerimova, A. A. 1997. Farsa dialekty. In V. S. Rastorgueva (ed.), Jazyki mira: Iranskie jazyki I. Jugo-zapadnye iranskie jazyki, 177-191. Moskva: Indrik.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: p. 178: 'Ударение силовое, обычно приходится на конец слова' (stress is dynamic, usually on the end of the word) with secondary stress in compounds and prefix/negation attraction in verbs. This describes the Southwestern Fars dialects (Buringuni, Somghuni, Masarmi, Papuni = Fars Dialects [fay], sout2645), NOT the spurious 'Northwestern Fars'; recorded here only to show it is already covered under sout2645.

sources.citation: Fennig, Chuck (Ethnologue). 2026. ISO 639-3 Change Request 2026-003: 'Deprecate Northwestern Fars [faz] as non-existent'. SIL International, ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about stress. p. 1: '"Fars, Northwestern" was included in Ethnologue with the 3-letter identifier [faz] in 2005.. The entry gives the location as "Scattered in isolated pockets of Fars Province" and with regard to dialects calls it "close to Sivandi". However, the most recent online entry is minimal, including a listed status of "Unattested".. Due to lack of attestation, the code element [faz] should be deprecated.' Change type: Retire, reason Nonexistent, status pending.

sources.citation: Hammarström, H., R. Forkel, M. Haspelmath & S. Bank. 2025. Glottolog 5.1, languoid page "Bookkeeping: Northwestern Fars" (nort2640).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about stress. States the entry 'has been retired.. because it was based on a misunderstanding'; all candidate referents already have entries: Sivandi [siy] (Lecoq 1979), Kalani/Abdu'i Southern Kurdish [sdh] (Andreas 1939: 359-483), Koruni Laki [lki] (Andreas 1939: 285-358), Tall-e Khedashk Gurani [hac] (Zhukovskij 1922: 82-85), Koroshi Balochi [ktl] (Nourzaei et al. 2015). Lists no descriptive reference of its own (Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology).
